# Preventive Vet

> Preventive Vet is a trusted resource for pet health, safety, and behavior guidance created by veterinary and behavior experts.

Preventive Vet provides comprehensive pet care resources including puppy training through Pupstanding Academy, DIY enrichment projects, digital educational books, and expert consultations. The site covers dog and cat health, behavior, safety, and wellness with practical guides, downloads, and certified trainer services.

## Key Topics

- Pet Health & Wellness
- Puppy Training & Socialization
- Dog Behavior & Training
- Cat Care & Behavior
- Pet Safety
- First Aid & Emergency Preparedness
- DIY Enrichment Projects
- Veterinary Care
- Resource Guarding
- Pupstanding Academy
- Cathy Madson
- Pet Poison Control
- Vaccination (Distemper, Parvo, Rabies)
- Free Resources & Downloads
- Virtual Training Consultations

## Core Resources & Education

- [Preventive Vet Homepage](https://www.preventivevet.com): Pet health, safety, behavior resources and expert guidance
- [Puppy Center](https://www.preventivevet.com/puppy-center): Comprehensive resources for raising healthy, socialized puppies
- [101 Essential Tips Digital Books: The Complete Collection](https://shop.preventivevet.com/collections/dog-books): Digital dog books on health, behavior training, and senior dog care
- [Cat Books Collection](https://shop.preventivevet.com/collections/cat-books): Digital cat books on health, safety, and senior cat care and wellness

## Dog Training & Behavior Programs

- [Pupstanding Academy: Dog Training Workshops](https://shop.preventivevet.com/collections/pupstanding-academy-dog-and-puppy-training-workshops): Online dog training workshops by certified trainer Cathy Madson
- [Virtual 1-on-1 Dog Training](https://shop.preventivevet.com/collections/virtual-1-on-1-dog-training): Virtual one-on-one dog training and behavior consultations with certified experts
- [Resource Guarding Foundations Course](https://shop.preventivevet.com/products/resource-guarding-foundations-course): Self-paced course on managing and fixing dog resource guarding behavior

## Pet Safety & Health Resources

- [Dog Helpful Resources & Downloads](https://www.preventivevet.com/dog-helpful-resources): Free dog resources, downloads, first aid guides, and emergency information
- [Cat Helpful Resources](https://www.preventivevet.com/cat-helpful-resources): Free cat resources, safety guides, calculators, and emergency preparedness
- [Pet-safe Disinfectant Products](https://shop.preventivevet.com/collections/best-pet-safe-disinfectant): iClean eco-friendly pet-safe disinfectant products for home cleaning

## DIY Enrichment & Play

- [Fun DIY Projects and Recipes for Dogs](https://www.preventivevet.com/dog-fun-diy-and-recipes): DIY dog toys, interactive puzzles, and homemade treat recipes for enrichment
- [Fun DIY Projects and Recipes for Cats](https://www.preventivevet.com/cat-fun-diy-and-recipes): DIY cat toys, enrichment projects, and homemade treat recipes for felines
- [The Best Fetch Toy For Dogs](https://shop.preventivevet.com/products/the-best-fetch-toy-for-dogs-large): Non-toxic safe fetch toy for dogs: safer stick alternative for play

## Community & Newsletter

- [Paws and Play Newsletter Signup](https://www.preventivevet.com/pawsandplaynews): Pet health tips, alerts, and special offers delivered to your inbox
